Walt Whitman (1819–1892).  Prose Works. 1892.

V. November Boughs

20. Elias Hicks: Portrait in Old Age

H
ERE
 is a portrait of E. H. from life, by Henry Inman, in New York, about 1827 or ’28. The painting was finely copper-plated in 1830, and the present is a fac simile. Looks as I saw him in the following narrative.
The time was signalized by the 
separation
 of the Society of Friends, so greatly talked of—and continuing yet—but so little really explain’d. (All I give of this separation is in a Note following.)
BORN … … MARCH 19, 1748.
DIED … … FEBRUARY 20, 1880.
